mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course) AS course_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE start_time > #{now}) AS upcoming_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE start_time <= #{now} AND end_time > #{now}) AS ongoing_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE end_time <= #{now}) AS ended_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollment WHERE status IN ('ENROLLED', 'COMPLETED')) AS active_enrollments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollment WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM enrollment WHERE status IN ('ENROLLED', 'COMPLETED')) AS participant_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user) AS user_count

SELECT c.id, c.title, c.instructor, c.start_time, c.end_time, c.capacity, c.enrolled_count, COALESCE(SUM(e.status = 'COMPLETED'), 0) AS completed_count FROM course c LEFT JOIN enrollment e ON e.course_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.enrolled_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(SUM(e.status = 'COMPLETED'), 0) / c.enrolled_count END DESC, c.enrolled_count DESC, c.id DESC
ORDER BY c.enrolled_count DESC, c.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
